info.title: qts research workbench API
info.description:
Run registry, trial ledger, config schema and background pipeline jobs of the `qts`
research workbench. Errors are RFC 7807 problem details (`application/problem+json`)
with a string `detail`. Non-finite floats (NaN / inf) are serialised as `null`.

get.summary: Effective warm-up for the default config
get.description:
Derived from ``risk.min_history_days``, ``alpha.train_min_days`` (with ML),
``alpha.horizon_days`` and the signal lag of the default ``SystemConfig``.  A
launch with ``config_overrides`` is checked against its own config.

avg_daily_cost_bps_of_nav.title: Avg Daily Cost Bps Of Nav

realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.title: Realized Vs Exante Vol Ratio
realized_vs_exante_vol_ratio.description: realised / ex-ante vol over invested days only; NaN (null) with too few

invested_day_frac.title: Invested Day Frac
invested_day_frac.description: share of decision days with gross exposure > 1e-4 of NAV

CostSeries.title: CostSeries
CostSeries.description: ``ColumnarSeries<CostComponent>``: USD per decision date by component.

days.title: Days
days.description: synthetic market length: at least the effective warm-up (GET /api/config/warmup) plus one year; checked against the run's own config at launch

max_days.title: Max Days
max_days.description: backtest only the last N out-of-sample days (quick runs)

LaunchRunRequest.title: LaunchRunRequest
LaunchRunRequest.description:
Strict types (pydantic strict mode): ``"stocks": "60"`` or ``"ml": "true"`` are
rejected, not coerced; the label may not contain control characters.

stocks.title: Stocks
stocks.description: universe size of the input data; null when not recorded

days.title: Days
days.description: days of market data; null when not recorded

RunConfig.title: RunConfig
RunConfig.description: Subset of ``SystemConfig`` the UI reads directly; the full YAML is in ``config_yaml``.

execution_venue.title: Execution Venue
execution_venue.description: routing venue of the execution layer, e.g. "closing auction (LOC/MOC)"; null for runs written before it was recorded

latest.description: null when the run has no exposure history

RunHeadline.title: RunHeadline
RunHeadline.description: Headline numbers shown in the runs list.

headline.description: null while running or after a failure

min_days.title: Min Days
min_days.description: warmup_days + one year (trading_days_per_year): the launch floor

risk_days.title: Risk Days
risk_days.description: risk exposures warm-up + min_history_days of factor returns

ml_days.title: Ml Days
ml_days.description: universe lead + alpha.train_min_days + embargo (upper bound); null without ML

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: true when the (exact) risk term binds

Warmup.title: Warmup
Warmup.description:
Effective warm-up of a run (``qts.pipeline.estimate_warmup_days``): trading
days of the market panel used before the first out-of-sample backtest date.

ApiErrorBody.description: RFC 7807 problem details (``application/problem+json``); ``detail`` is always a string.
